asked: # Install docs: Hostinger setup steps Add a Hostinger section to axHub's install/setup docs (find the existing install files, e.g. INSTALL.md, README setup, docs/install). Keep it short, numbered, phone-readable. Never include real secret values. Steps to document: 1. Get a Hostinger API [hidden] -> Account -> API -> create token (note scopes needed: DNS, VPS, domains). Never paste it into chat. 2. Add it to Coolify: open the axHub app -> Environment Variables -> add HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN, mark as secret, save, redeploy axHub. 3. Verify: ask Claude/Amber to run a Hostinger DNS read through axHub. 4. Claude connector (optional, direct): in Claude Settings -> Connectors, add the Hostinger connector; start a new chat so its tools load. 5. axHub MCP route: a separate branch (claude/axhub-mcp-service) adds an `mcp` service type and a `hostinger-mcp` service; note it may need the same token and link to that PR once it exists. If key names differ there, use whatever that branch defines and mention HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN as the default. Open a PR, do not merge or deploy. No sub-agents. Clean commits. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
